## Goal
A running FastAPI skeleton with config, health endpoint, DB session, Docker image, tests and the CI gates.

**Depends on:** F00
**Built by:** `backend-dev`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `docker build` and `docker run` work, and `GET /api/health` returns `{app, db, llm}`
- [ ] `make check` passes (lint, tests, import boundaries, OpenAPI drift)
- [ ] CI runs the gates from 0010 and is green
- [ ] Branch protection on `main` requires these checks (student, on GitHub)

## Read first
- `docs/wiki/backend/README.md`, `modules.md`, `configuration.md`, `persistence.md`
- `docs/wiki/decisions/0005-fastapi-and-vanilla-js-single-container.md`, `0006-sqlite-behind-repository-layer.md`, `0010-ci-gates-before-merge.md`
